About the Grande

The Grande comes in two sizes, 29' by 13'9" and 23' by 11'3", so it can suit a typical Jacksonville lot or a smaller one without changing style. It's a simple rectangle, which keeps it easy to match with pavers, a screen enclosure or a modern home.

Bench seating at both the shallow and deep ends gives you places to sit wherever you are in the pool, and the swim lane runs the length of the shell. Both versions reach close to 6' deep, so even the smaller Grande 23 offers real depth for its size.

Who is the Grande best for?

Typical suburban lots, and owners who want simple lines with seating at both ends.

How much yard does the Grande need?

As a first estimate, allow about 37' by 22' for the Grande 29, which adds a 4-foot walkway on each side, or about 31' by 20' for the Grande 23. Your setbacks, easements and deck plans decide the real limit, and we confirm them on the free site visit.

Grande questions

Yes, the Grande can suit a small Jacksonville yard. Its smallest version is 23' by 11'3", before you allow for a deck and setbacks. iTop Pools measures your yard on a free site visit and confirms whether it fits.

The Grande 29 holds about 12,200 gallons. The Grande 23 holds about 7,400 gallons. These figures come from Barrier Reef Pools USA.

The Grande 29 goes from 3'5" to 5'10". The Grande 23 goes from 3'5.5" to 5'10.5".

The Grande has no built-in spa or lounging ledge listed. Ask iTop Pools what can be added to it.
